rounds.literal: Monna o tsenya nko ya gagwe mo pitseng ya moagisani, mosi o mo tlala mo sefatlhegong.
options: go itshunya mo ditabeng tsa ba bangwe
go fofonela sengwe se se monate
rounds.story: Ba dirisa seno fa motho a iphitlhela a bua ka dilo tse di sa mo ameng kgotsa a laela kwa a sa kopiwang teng.

rounds.literal: Ngwana o lebile kuku ka matlho a magolo, molomo o eme fela, mme matlho e kete ke one a e jang.
options: go eletsa sengwe thata o sa se ame
rounds.story: Go buiwa jaana fa motho a ntse a lebeletse se a se batlang thata, jaaka diaparo, koloi kgotsa dijo.

rounds.literal: Mosetsana o tshwere pelo ya pampiri e e robegileng ka bogare, dikeledi di elela.
rounds.story: Ba se dirisa fa mafoko kgotsa tiro ya mongwe e hutsafatsa motho thata.

rounds.literal: Rre o tshwere pelo ya gagwe ka diatla tsotlhe, a eme ka tidimalo fa pula e na.
rounds.story: Fa go le thata mo botshelong, motho o laolwa gore a tshware pelo ka diatla mme a nne pelotelele.

rounds.literal: Mme o bula matlho a magolo jaaka mabati, lesedi le tlala mo ntlong.
rounds.story: Idiomo e dirisiwa fa kgang kgotsa tiragalo e dira gore motho a bone dilo ka tsela e ntšha.

rounds.literal: Monna o dutse fa thoko a phuthile matsogo, ba bangwe ba dira tiro tsotlhe.
rounds.story: Fa batho ba bangwe ba bereka wena o lebeletse fela, go twe o phuthile matsogo.

rounds.literal: Mosimane o loma loleme la gagwe pele mafoko a tswa, matlho a gagwe a gakgametse.
options: go ithiba gore o se bue
rounds.story: Seno se dirisiwa fa motho a batla go bua sengwe mme a itshwara gore go se tswe.

rounds.literal: Mosadi o gatela menwana ya monna ka phoso, monna o tlola ka botlhoko.
rounds.story: Fa mafoko kgotsa ditiro tsa gago di utlwisa mongwe botlhoko mo maikutlong, o gatile mo menwaneng.

rounds.literal: Ngwana o tshwere pelo e tshweu e e phatsimang jaaka seaparo se se sa tswang go tlhatswiwa.
rounds.story: Ba bua jaana ka motho yo o ratang go thusa, yo o se nang boferefere mo pelong.

rounds.literal: Monna o bofile mpa ka thapo, a leba kgoteng ya dijo e e se nang sepe.
options: go itshokela tlhaelo ya madi kgotsa dijo
rounds.story: Fa madi a le mannye kgotsa dijo di tlhokega, batho ba re ba bofile mpa.

kids.idiom: Ngwana yo o sa leleng o swela tharing
kids.literal: Lesea le didimetse mo tharing, mme dijo di le gaufi fela.
options: o tshwanetse go kopa kgotsa go bua fa o tlhoka thuso
o tshwanetse go robala letsatsi lotlhe
bana ga ba a tshwanela go bua
dijo tsotlhe di jewa ke bagolo
kids.story: Fa o sa bolele se o se tlhokang, batho ba ka se itse. Ke ka moo bagolo ba buang jaana.

kids.literal: Dinku tse pedi di tshwarane ka mabogo jaaka bana ba thusana go tsaya nkgo.
options: batho ba thusa fa ba dira mmogo
dinku di tshwanetse go tsenngwa mo lesakeng
motho a le mongwe o dira tsotlhe
kids.story: Fa tiro e le boima, go nna bonolo fa mongwe le mongwe a thusa.

kids.literal: Ngwana o tshegeditswe ke diatla tse dintsi, a ema sentle mo gare ga batho.
options: re phela sentle ka go thusana
motho o tshwanetse go nna nosi ka tsotlhe
madi a botlhokwa go feta batho
kids.story: Polelo eno e ruta bana gore botshelo bo agega ka lorato, tlotlo le thuso ya ba bangwe.

kids.idiom: Mma ngwana o tshwara thipa ka fa bogaleng
kids.literal: Mma o tshwere thipa ka fa bogaleng gore ngwana a se ka a gobala.
options: motsadi o sireletsa ngwana le fa go le thata
bana ba tshwanetse go tshameka ka dithipa
mma o rata go apea fela
thipa e botoka go feta khaba
kids.story: E dirisiwa go bontsha gore motsadi o ikemiseditse go itshokela botlhoko go sireletsa ngwana.

kids.idiom: Mosu ga o tswelele kwa godimo o sa tswa molelo
kids.literal: Mosu o tlhatloga mo legodimong, mme kwa tlase go na le molelo o monnye o tukang.
options: fa go na le sesupo, gantsi go na le lebaka
mosu o ka tswa mo metsing
molelo ga o kotsi le ka motlha
kids.story: Fa batho ba bona sengwe se sa tlwaelegang, ba gakologelwa gore gantsi go na le sengwe se se se bakang.

kids.literal: Mosimane o tsamaya a goga dinao mo loroleng, lerole le sala morago.
options: go dira sengwe ka bonya kgotsa ka go sa batle
kids.story: Bagolo ba rialo fa ngwana a diega go dira tiro kgotsa a tsamaya a sa batle go ya.

kids.literal: Monna o itaya sehuba ka seatla, a bua a ikgogomosa fa pele ga batho.
options: go ikgantsha ka se o se dirileng
kids.story: Fa mongwe a nna a iphaka kgotsa a ipoka thata, re re o itaya sehuba.

kids.literal: Rre o tlhatswa diatla fa kgang e santse e le mo tafoleng.
options: go ikgogela kwa thoko mo kgang
kids.story: Fa motho a re ga a sa batla go amana le bothata jo bo rileng, go twe o tlhatswa diatla.

kids.idiom: go lala ka leitlho le le lengwe
kids.literal: Mosetsana o robetse ka leitlho le lengwe le bulegile, le lengwe le tswetswe.
options: go nna kelotlhoko kgotsa o tshwenyegile
kids.story: Fa motho a sa phuthologa ka gonne a tlhokometse sengwe kgotsa a tshwenyegile, ba bua jaana.

kids.literal: Kgosi e bua mo kgotleng, mafoko a yone a fetoga mela e e kwadilweng mo pampiring.
options: taelo ya yo o eteletseng e tshwanetse go latelwa
mafoko otlhe a lekana ka tsotlhe
bana ba tshwanetse go bua pele ga bagolo
kids.story: Polelo eno e ruta bana gore fa yo o eteletseng a bua, ba bangwe ba tshwanetse go reetsa taelo.
